_meta.title: Philippine Crops Seed Data
_meta.description: Reference dataset of common crops grown in the Philippines, intended for seeding a crop database / autocomplete feature. Values are practical estimates compiled from Philippine agricultural extension references (DA-ATI, Bureau of Plant Industry, PCAARRD) and general agronomic sources.
_meta.disclaimer: Days to harvest, fertilization rates, and yield per plant vary significantly by variety/cultivar, soil type, climate, season, spacing, and management practices. These figures are general planning estimates, NOT precise agronomic recommendations. For commercial or precision farming, verify with a local agriculturist, soil analysis, or the Department of Agriculture / LGU agriculture office.

units.days_to_harvest: days after seeding or transplanting, as specified per crop

_meta.fertilization_schedule_notes: Each fertilization stage now includes a 'schedule' object with numeric day offsets (day_offset_min/max, default_day_offset) counted from the crop's planting_reference (seeding or transplanting, matching days_to_harvest.basis), plus 'recurring', 'interval_days_min/max', 'default_interval_days', and 'repeat_until_harvest' for stages that repeat through the fruiting/harvest period. 'estimated: true' flags stages where the source only gave a growth-stage trigger (e.g. 'at flowering') with no explicit day count, so the offset was inferred from typical crop timing rather than taken directly from a source. These numeric fields are what the app should read for automated task scheduling; the original 'timing' text is kept for display/human reference.
